overview.text: The Middle American Indigo Snake (Blacktail Cribo) is a big, harmless snake from southern Texas through Mexico and Central America to northern South America.

identification.text: Glossy olive-brown that turns black towards the tail, with a lighter olive-yellow belly and dark marks around the head.

size.label: Adults
size.text: From about 1.8 m to over 2.4 m long.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Southern Texas, Mexico, Central America, and Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador and Peru.

recognise.text: Large, glossy olive-brown snake with a black tail.
